run_sample_commonsenset2i: run the script to generate images from the CommonsenseT2I dataset using MetaQueryPipeline with configurable prompts and checkpoints
run_generate_images: run generate_images to sample and save images from text prompts using a MetaQuery pipeline with optional negative prompts
run_sample_metaquery: run sample_metaquery to generate 4 images per prompt using the MetaQueryPipeline with guidance scale and inference steps
run_get_grid: run get_grid to arrange 4 PIL images into a 2x2 grid image for saving
run_main: run main to load a MetaQueryPipeline checkpoint, load the CommonsenseT2I dataset, and generate images for both prompt columns
